chapter: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Blazing Poetry
act_title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Blazing Poetry

quests.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Blazing Poetry

dialogue.t: This is a super special view, isn't it?
So much water, super special colors, mm!

dialogue.sit: You two sound like you could be siblings.
Ah, the two of you possess such splendid vocabularies.
A super special view!

dialogue.t: But it is very special, isn't it? How would you describe it, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: Like Cryo...
Like Anemo?

dialogue.t: What's that even supposed to mean?
But this place really is special. {NICKNAME}, do you still remember that artist from before?

dialogue.sit: Vermeer, you mean?
Sorry, who now?

dialogue.t: That's right! That's him! Didn't we help him place those glowing pearls into two giant statues?
He even gave us a painting afterward!

dialogue.sit: Is this what you're looking for?

dialogue.t: It should be... here! Come have a look, Kichiboushi!
Mm! Very alike! Is it photo?
No, someone drew this.
Eh? But... if people have photo, why drawing?
Huh. Actually, why is that, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: I suppose people have a desire to make something that is uniquely theirs.
Kameras are pretty expensive, you know.

dialogue.t: Huh, that sounds reasonable.

dialogue.sit: Something that you draw yourself has much more sentimental value.

dialogue.t: That's true, drawing something out brushstroke by brushstroke is pretty hard!
Mm... Then is taking photos of me easy, not-hard, and not-sentimental?
Eh!? N—No, that's not it, we just...

dialogue.sit: Drawing takes a long time, you know. It's pretty tiring.

dialogue.t: That's right! If we spend too long drawing, your legs might fall asleep on you from all that standing still.
When I was sealed in stone, always standing.
So when freed from seal, a long time later, legs very sore.
Ergh, that sounds very painful...
But Paimon can flip-flap. Legs won't be sore.
Hey now! Floating's a full-body exercise. It's super tiring!
Ooh, fire flower!
Hey, are you listening, or what?

dialogue.sit: A Flaming Flower, you mean?

dialogue.t: That's true, Chinju Forest doesn't have any Flaming Flowers at all...
Do you want one, Kichiboushi?
Yes! Looks very warming.
Then you'd better ask {NICKNAME} nicely!
{NICKNAME}, wants! Thank you.
Do all bake-danuki talk like this...
This is a super special view, isn't it?
So much water, super special colors, mm!

dialogue.sit: Like Cryo...
Like Anemo?

dialogue.t: What's that even supposed to mean?
This place has a great view, though. Really makes Paimon wanna draw!

dialogue.sit: You can draw, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Paimon can learn!
Drawing... But drawing is very hard. Watched Utamarou draw. Took very long for one drawing.
Why do people drawing when they have photo?
Huh. Actually, why is that, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.t: That's true, Chinju Forest doesn't have any Flaming Flowers at all...
Do you want one, Kichiboushi?
Yes! Looks very warming.
Then you'd better ask {NICKNAME} nicely!
{NICKNAME}, wants! Thank you.
...He doesn't sound all that sincere. Or do bake-danuki just talk like that?
{NICKNAME}, want fire flower. Thanks.
So warm.
If we had a Flaming Flower at Dragonspine, would be good!
He's got a point. We should probably have gone better prepared...
Paimon, if we had a very big flower, could we make the snowy mountain have no snow?
P—Probably not...
Mm.

dialogue.sit: We could take Kichiboushi to see a "very big Flaming Flower."

dialogue.t: Eh? Wait, you mean...

dialogue.sit: I mean the Pyro Regisvine, of course.
Let's get going.

dialogue.t: Alright then, guess that's Kichiboushi's training for today!
So big! So hot! Amazing to have big fire flower!
Right? Ooh, also...
Hang on a moment, Kichiboushi. Let's take a photo of you!

dialogue.sit: In this steaming hot place?

dialogue.t: That's the whole point!
Mm... Okay...
Ooh.. So hot...
Hehe, guess you know now, eh, Kichiboushi?
Mm?

dialogue.sit: Know what, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Can you imagine if we had to draw you?
And that's why we chose to take photos instead! It's not that we don't care. It's precisely because we care about you that we decided to save time!

dialogue.sit: Oh, so that's what you were intending to do.
Ridiculous...
You're not wrong, but it's still way too hot in here...

dialogue.t: Understood. Photo, good. So... hot...

dialogue.sit: Let's take the heat source out. The quicker, the better.

dialogue.t: Mmmm...
{NICKNAME}, so strong!

dialogue.sit: I'm so-so.
We've fought this sort of thing enough times by now.

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME} and Paimon fight often?
Come to think of it, the goal of our journey is to help you find your lost relative, but we always wind up in fights along the way.

dialogue.sit: It's fine. I quite like fights.
Battles are bothersome, honestly.

dialogue.t: Well... That's nice and all, but there's better hobbies out there for sure, right?
When I become great bake-danuki, will become as strong as {NICKNAME}.
You can do it for sure! But you've got to promise Paimon...
Yes, Paimon?
Well... Ahem! Even if you become a powerful bake-danuki like Ioroi, promise that you won't bully those weaker than you, or pick fights whenever you want!
Don't be like that big, fiery, flower that started spewing flames the moment it saw {NICKNAME}!
Then when is fighting okay?

dialogue.sit: When it's self-defense...
When you need to protect others...
When you need to stand up for what's right...

dialogue.t: Mm... Not really understanding, but I promise Paimon. No bullying weak people, no picking fights.
That's a good boy, Kichiboushi!
Next up... Huh, this should be the final stop out of the eight that Ioroi set down...
Mm...

quests.description: You agreed to Ioroi’s request to “bring Kichiboushi out to train.” Paimon plans to take him to see Luhua Pool today…
